verdict.rationale: Install scope is a fair question for a skills package, so the axis applies. The evidence documents installing via `npx skills add` and `yy skills install`, but nowhere mentions choosing between project-local, repo-committed files and a user-global install. The isolated configuration directory for validating an unpublished checkout is an adjacent testing arrangement, not an install-scope option.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose install scope — project-local files committed with my repo, or user-global across all projects
